race.comment: GEORGIA PINES (7) kicked off his career with a win a week-and-a-half ago, leading and getting home by 7 metres over 1609m at Newcastle. Gets a soft run on the inside of the second line but may need luck at some point. Has upside and is a leading hope if she gets the gaps. WICKED LEGEND (8) has been close to the mark here of late and again performed admirably last start, coming from this row and making up plenty of ground but finding a couple better. Up to a distance where he has recorded a win and two placings from three attempts. Good enough to win a race of this calibre. SHESTERKIN (9) has to come into calculations on the back of some strong recent form, most recently when fourth from this row. Race fit now and must be included. BETTORBYTHESEA (10) may need luck from this barrier but hasn't been too far away of late.
